map.运动技术动作稳定性评分工具，通过多次试举/试投的成绩偏差分析，量化评估动作稳定性: A movement-stability scoring tool that quantifies stability by analyzing result variance across multiple attempts/throws. The smaller the standard deviation, the higher the stability.
map.Coefficient of variation(CV)是衡量动作稳定性的核心统: The coefficient of variation (CV) is the core statistical metric for movement stability
map.CV=标准差/平均值×100%，越小越稳定: CV = standard deviation/mean x 100%; the smaller, the more stable
map.CV≤2%为极稳定，2-5%为较稳定，5-10%为一般: CV <= 2% is very stable, 2-5% fairly stable, 5-10% average
map.适用于举重、投掷、射击等需要重复动作的运动: Applies to weightlifting, throwing, shooting and other sports requiring repeated movements
map.评估深蹲轨迹稳定性，量化左右不对称改善幅度。: rehab training to assess squat-path stability and quantify how much left-right asymmetry improves.
map.10 次动作时长 SD/均值=CV；CV<5% 为稳定，>15% 需修正。: For 10 movement durations, SD/mean = CV; CV < 5% is stable, > 15% needs correction.
map.标准差越小越好？: Is a smaller standard deviation better?
map.在正确动作模式下越小越稳；若伴随幅度不足，需结合动作质量一起看。: Under the correct movement pattern, smaller means more stable; if range of motion is insufficient, judge it together with movement quality.
map.运动技术动作稳定性评分工具通过多次试举/试投的成绩统计，计算平均值、标准差和变异: The movement-stability scoring tool uses the statistics of multiple attempts/throws to compute the mean, standard deviation, and coefficient of variation (CV), quantifying movement stability.
